First in the long jump we clocked two second spots with Darragh O’Farrell registering a legal pb of 7.45m closely followed by Richard Danso with another best of 7.44m – a wind reading of +2.1 mps prevented it being a pb for him too.

Richard Danso had big fouls and finished second in the B on count back – again ahead of the WGwEL men. Mick Jones then had a good series in the hammer and was ably supported by event debutant Mark Allen and still we were on our predicted points target as attention switched to the track.
